title: devdeck stack
description: stacks/<name>.yaml: the services that start together, and in what order.

compose.description: Docker Compose files that provide the dependencies (databases, queues, identity). One file, or a list of files that start together.

requires.description: Things this stack needs but devdeck doesn't start, such as a database running on this machine. The stack is refused until each one answers.

tcp.description: host:port on this machine that accepts connections, for example 127.0.0.1:5432.

services.description: The processes devdeck runs. A stack with only compose files needs none.

repo.description: Id of the repo that holds the file.

services.description: Only start these compose services. Empty means all.

repo.description: Id of the repo this service runs from.

cmd.description: What to run: a Go package or a shell command, depending on kind.

dir.description: Folder inside the repo to run from.

env.description: Plain values only. Secrets come from the keychain.

after.description: Ids of services that must be ready first.

ready.description: How devdeck knows the service is ready: exactly one of http, tcp or log.

http.description: A URL that answers with success.

log.description: A text that appears in the logs.

log_parser.description: Which log parser plugin reads this service's output.
